Title: Master of Numbers
Description: Experience the excitement of mathematics with Master of Numbers, a fast-paced online game. Race to collect beneficial numbers while dodging harmful ones, enhancing your math and strategy skills as you progress through increasingly challenging levels. Play on your phone or computer for an engaging mental workout.
Instructions:
The goal: to reach the finish line by typing the maximum possible number.
Absorb numbers smaller than yours highlighted in blue. If you encounter a red number larger than yours, you will lose your number and you will have to start over.
Avoid electric saws, cross bridges and jump over ditches.
At the finish line you will find a lot of walls to destroy

Title: Dinosaur Game
Description:
Dino Dash is a fast, fun, and action-packed endless runner game that sends players racing through a colorful prehistoric world. Take control of a brave little dinosaur and dash across ancient landscapes filled with danger, surprises, and exciting challenges. Your goal is simple: run as far as possible, avoid every obstacle in your path, and keep your adventure going for as long as you can.

As the speed increases, your reflexes will be put to the test. Jump over hazards, dodge tricky barriers, and react quickly as the world rushes past you. Every run feels fresh as you try to beat your best distance, collect more coins, and master the timing needed to survive longer. The easy-to-learn controls make Dino Dash perfect for quick casual play, while the increasing difficulty keeps the game exciting for players who love chasing high scores.
Instructions: Arrow keys or swipe to jump or duck. Avoid obstacles as you attempt to run as far as possible. Multiple modes: Endless, Levels and challenges.

Title: Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami
Description:
Welcome to Obby Saves Brainrots from Tsunami!

A fast-paced escape game that blends tsunami runner, idle game, and idle tycoon mechanics into one addictive experience. Run, jump, and survive while escaping giant waves, collecting brainrots, and building your Brainrot empire.

This is more than just a runner. Escape Brainrots Tsunami Obby is a true survival runner with long-term progression, idle systems, and satisfying upgrades.

Escape the Tsunami

A massive tsunami is coming and you must escape before it reaches you. Every second matters.

🌊 Classic tsunami obby and tsunami runner gameplay

🏃 Run fast, jump obstacles, and survive dangerous zones

⚡ Reflex-based escape game mechanics

Collect Brainrots and Progress

Brainrots are the main resource in this game. The more you collect, the faster your empire grows.

🧠 Collect brainrots during runs

💸 Turn brainrots into money

📈 Grow into a powerful idle tycoon
Instructions:
Collect brainrots, craft them, and get the rarest brainrots by building an empire!

Computer controls:
WASD - to move
E - interact with objects
G - throw brain rot
F - turn on cursor

Use the UI to control mobile devices

Title: Lumbering At Sea
Description: Set sail on an endless ocean adventure in Lumbering At Sea, a captivating 3D stickman runner with lumberjack action! Control a nimble stickman lumberjack dashing across glowing paths on tropical islands, chopping trees to harvest wood planks while racing toward distant checkpoints. The core idea is resource timing and raft-building progression—perfectly time your axe swings to collect enough lumber to construct a raft that propels you to the next island before falling into the sea or running out of momentum.
Instructions:
Your main goal is to run forward along the path, time axe swings to chop trees and automatically collect wood (guided by on-screen indicators or proximity), gather coins for upgrades, and reach the end gate or next island before falling off or losing progress. Build your raft with collected lumber to advance—survive longer runs for high scores by upgrading speed, cutting efficiency, and critical hits between attempts!

PC Controls:
Mouse: Click/tap (or hold/repeatedly click) to swing the axe when near trees or indicators appear.

Mobile Controls:
Touchscreen: Tap the screen to swing the axe and chop trees when close or prompted (follow indicators for timing).
